title: Replace wall-blind overflow with safe placement or explicit infeasibility

root_cause.boundary: frontend/src/model/overflow.ts::overflowRows (anchor-first sequential placement) + frontend/src/store/controller.ts::Controller.autoSequence (wall- and pin-blind overflow staging)
root_cause.mechanism: overflowRows laid dropped rows back-to-back from the frame anchor and skipped non-permeable calendar walls (FEEDBACK-02), but it was still blind to immutable pinned rows and silently omitted any row that could not fit before a wall running to end of day — an over-assigned day could stage a row overlapping a pinned commitment or lose work with no diagnostic; the production path had no explicit infeasibility state

frontend_production: frontend/src/model/overflow.ts: new planOverflow(dropped, anchor, blocksOf, walls, occupied) — free-gap scan treating non-permeable calendar walls AND immutable pinned-row intervals as blocked; a row no gap can hold is returned in infeasible as {id, blocks, freeBlocks (largest remaining contiguous gap in 30-min blocks), reason naming the gap, the need, and the obstacle (walls / pins / day-runs-out)}
frontend/src/model/overflow.ts: overflowRows is now a thin wrapper over planOverflow().rows — one algorithm, legacy callers and tests unchanged

frontend/src/store/controller.ts: autoSequence calls planOverflow with occupied = the server's effective pin set (result.pinnedRows ?? pendingPinnedRows, zone rows filtered), so overflow never overlaps a manual or recurring auto-pin; infeasible rows are NOT staged, and their diagnostics append to the sequence warnings as '⚠ overflow infeasible — <id>: <reason>' so they render in alerts and gate shadow/commit behind LD24 acceptance
Final merged sequence stays sorted byStartThenId (FEEDBACK-01) — chronological order preserved; the sort reorders, never drops
fix.no_backend_production_change: app/sequence.py unchanged — FEEDBACK-02 already hardens non-permeable calendar walls; new tests pin the backend half of the explicit-infeasibility contract (immutable pinned-row overlap is never silent; a sequence omitting an infeasible row is rejected loudly by never-bump)
fix.no_store_change: infeasibility rides the existing SEQUENCE_OK warnings path — no new AppState field or action payload; acceptableDefects/alerts already render it and defectsResolved already gates

regression_tests.behavior: places rows into free gaps around walls AND occupied pins; straddling row moves after the wall; rows with no free gap reported infeasible with id/need/freeBlocks and a reason naming the gap (17:30-18:00) and obstacle; pin occupying the only gap reported with 'pinned row'; legacy overflowRows omission now visible via planOverflow.infeasible; all-day rows skipped never infeasible; no anchor reports every row infeasible instead of a midnight pile

mocked full-day non-permeable calendar wall: every dropped row reported as 'overflow infeasible' warning naming rows (Magic Mirror, Note Processing) and capacity (block text), zero overflow rows staged, defectsResolved false (gates shadow/commit); mocked server pinnedRows: every overflow row avoids the pinned 07:30-09:00 interval and every effective calendar wall

row overlapping an immutable pinned row yields a named unexpected_overlap warning, never a clean pass; a merged sequence omitting a row the overflow could not place is rejected loudly (never-bump names the missing row), never ok

safety_proof.live_post_sequence_adjust_commit: none — all tests use FixtureAdapter, vitest mocks, and pure unit fixtures; no adapter call reaches a live endpoint
safety_proof.branch_or_index_mutation: none — no commit, stage, reset, clean, stash, rebase, or merge
safety_proof.foreign_changes_preserved: tracked dirty work (.gitignore, AGENTS.md, README.md, gem-team.yaml, .opencode, extraction plan.yaml) untouched; edited files live in untracked app/ and frontend/ dirs, same as FEEDBACK-01/02

out_of_scope_noted: event classification changes (FF-CAL-01/FF-06) — quarantined frontend projection still maps to fixed, unchanged
hardening pinned rows to backend hard walls — kept on the LD26 acceptable-defect path per FEEDBACK-02's scope; the frontend avoids generating the shape entirely
store.ts acceptableDefects unchanged — verified infeasibility warnings flow through the existing defects path
